error.bad_speakers: Choose from 1 to 10 participants, or Not sure.
error.biometric_unavailable: There's no fingerprint on this phone. Add one in Android settings, or the app won't open.
error.busy: Something is already being processed. Wait for it to finish.

error.models_download_corrupt: A model file arrived damaged. Try again.

error.models_incomplete: Speech models are not fully downloaded. Download them on the home screen.
